category_edits.rationale: Across all four datasets, chronological nonpadding ranks may share positional evidence across short histories of different lengths. Include mask tokens in the ranks and keep padding at zero. The generated predictor imports this same model class, so training and inference use identical features without changing embedding shapes, topology, readout, loss or optimizer.

response.change_summary: Replace padded-slot position IDs with chronological nonpadding ranks in all four BERT4Rec category models, automatically shared by the generated predictor.
